notes: Seoul, May 1967, Korean narration (대한뉴스 623호): at the National Election Commission, party representatives under the newsreel lights take turns drawing slips from a box to fix their ballot numbers; the long window is the result read out — an official with the paper, then party names stacked up one by one on screen as the narrator counts them, 1 to 11, into the finished ballot chart. fetched from e영상역사관 (ehistory.go.kr) via its WeNMediaPlayer file-info proxy → hdvod.ktv.go.kr 360P HLS; KTV's 16:9 transfer centre-cropped to 4:3.
